# each quarter's cut = (flipped left-right, flipped top-bottom) relative to the cut made in the bottom-left quarter
cut = {"BL": (0, 0)}
def unfold_vertical(q):   # right half folded onto the left: mirror into the right quarters
    out = dict(q)
    for k, (fx, fy) in q.items():
        out[k.replace("L", "R")] = (1 - fx, fy)
    return out
def unfold_horizontal(q): # top half folded onto the bottom: mirror into the top quarters
    out = dict(q)
    for k, (fx, fy) in q.items():
        out["T" + k[1]] = (fx, 1 - fy)
    return out
result = unfold_horizontal(unfold_vertical(cut))

check_code:
from itertools import product, combinations
# element types (L, T, S, D) allowed by: All L are T, All T are S, No L is D
types = [t for t in product((0, 1), repeat=4)
         if (not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[1] or t[2]) and not (t[0] and t[3])]
models = []
for r in range(1, len(types) + 1):
    for m in combinations(types, r):
        if all(any(t[i] for t in m) for i in range(4)):   # every class non-empty
            models.append(m)
I   = [all(t[1] for t in m if t[3]) for m in models]
II  = [any(t[2] and t[3] for t in m) for m in models]
III = [not any(t[2] and t[3] for t in m) for m in models]
follows = {n: all(v) for n, v in (("I", I), ("II", II), ("III", III))}
either = (not follows["II"] and not follows["III"] and all(a != b for a, b in zip(II, III)))
if either and not follows["I"]:
    result = "either II or III"
else:
    result = "only " + "+".join(n for n, f in follows.items() if f)
opts = {"A": "only II", "B": "either II or III", "C": "only I", "D": "only III"}

match = [k for k, v in opts.items() if v == result]
assert len(match) == 1
print(f"ANSWER={match[0]}")

def inter(a, b):
    (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = a; (x3, y3), (x4, y4) = b
    d = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
